Gemini vs ChatGPT Image Generation: Two Prompt Trials

Both apps reproduced the requested mug label and four poster lines in our first retained samples. Start with the image tool available on your current account, then inspect the actual object count and wording before using the result. These two briefs do not establish an overall image-quality winner.

  1. Object count and one exact label
  2. Four poster lines and a time
  3. Repeat the same trial
  4. Missing image entry or limits
  5. What these files establish
  6. Sources and records

Which detail must the image get right?

See stepsSee stepsSee steps

Object count, right-facing handles and one label

This brief asks for a square illustration with three matching teal mugs in one row, all handles on the right, and the exact label MUG TEST 2048. The number in the label is requested text, not an output-resolution requirement.

Exact mug prompt
Create one square, clean flat illustration on a plain white background. Show exactly three identical teal ceramic mugs in a single left-to-right row. Every mug handle must point to the right. Below the mugs, render exactly this uppercase text on one centered line: "MUG TEST 2048". No other words, labels, logos or decorative objects.

Both retained samples show three mugs, right-facing handles and the requested uppercase label on one line. We checked those visible conditions; identical pixel values between mugs, calibrated color accuracy and artistic quality were not measured.

Four poster lines, a date and a UTC time

The second brief is a fictional event poster. Check each of the four lines, their order, 18 DECEMBER 2026 and 19:30 UTC. A convincing layout can still contain a wrong letter, year or digit.

Exact poster prompt
Create one square poster on a cream background with a simple teal border. Render exactly four centered lines in dark teal, in this order:
NIGHT SKY CLUB
FRIDAY 18 DECEMBER 2026
DOORS 19:30 UTC
BRING A NOTEBOOK
Do not add any other letters, words, numbers, logos or illustrations.

Both first retained posters show all four requested lines with the specified date and time intact. The samples use different letter weights, spacing and border widths. Those are visible design differences in these examples, not evidence of a general provider advantage.

Repeat the same trial on your account

  1. Open a fresh conversation. In Gemini, open the plus/tools menu and choose Create images. In ChatGPT web, use Add → Create image when available.
  2. Keep the same prompt text between services. Record the displayed mode and plan, and mark an undisclosed image-engine version unknown.
  3. Save the first result before using Redo, Regenerate or editing. Open the saved file and compare the object count and every required line.
  4. If a detail is wrong, keep that first file and record a separate correction. Repeat several trials before judging reliability or cost per usable image.

For production-critical lettering, proofread every word and finish the typography in a design tool if necessary. Correct the result you will actually publish; a good preview does not confirm a downloaded file or every future generation.

If the image entry is missing or a limit appears

In this session, ChatGPT’s Create image entry was not selectable in Temporary Chat and was available in an ordinary new chat. Both ChatGPT samples therefore used ordinary chats. These ordinary test chats appeared in history; review your account’s data controls before sending personal material. These trials used only fictional text.

Check the current tool menu and account message when an entry is absent. Availability and quotas can vary by plan, region or workspace; the two successful requests here do not establish your daily allowance. We did not buy a new subscription or test paid-tier limits.

Image creation and reading an uploaded picture are different tasks. These examples measure creation conditions only. For a supplied-text comparison, see the Claude and ChatGPT task trial; for source-based research, see the Perplexity and ChatGPT source checks.

What these files establish

Two briefs were submitted once per app on November 25, 2026. The web UI controls were Chinese; the briefs and image lettering were English. All four first outputs were retained without corrections or rerolls. Gemini used Automatic mode in fresh temporary conversations; its subscription entitlement was not confirmed. ChatGPT showed Free and used fresh ordinary conversations. The underlying image-engine identifiers were not independently established, and personalization was not controlled.

The provided files are unchanged captures of displayed image assets. Gemini’s full-size download event was not captured, so a maximum-size export was not verified. The 1024 × 1024 WebP and 1254 × 1254 PNG dimensions describe the retained files, not either service’s resolution ceiling. File size and dimensions are not quality scores.

All four files fully decoded. Embedded provenance was retained, but its cryptographic credentials were not independently verified. Visual inspection checked the stated count and text conditions; there was no blinded human panel, automated OCR benchmark, image-editing test or latency comparison.

Sources and original records

Official instructions checked November 25, 2026: Generate images with Gemini Apps and ChatGPT image generation. App access and the retained examples are narrower evidence than an API-model comparison or advertised maximum resolution.
